items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1964-11-28
items.q: Well, he, Jolly liked Zutty, he was playing.

ctx.x: I don't believe I've ever heard that orchestrated for a band, you know?
I just noticed that Zutty played drums on all those General Sats, too.
Yeah, he was there. Well, he, Jolly liked Zutty, he was playing.
